#!/bin/sh
printf 'kith-stub %s\n' "$*" >> "$DIFFTEST_FAKELOG"
while [ "$1" != -- ]; do
  case $1 in --lock-dir) lock=$2; shift ;; --key) key=$2; shift ;; --status-fd) fd=$2; shift ;; esac
  shift

  [ -n "$fd" ] && eval "echo busy >&$fd"
  exit 75
fi

exec "$@"

#!/bin/sh
printf 'kith-stub %s\n' "$*" >> "$DIFFTEST_FAKELOG"
while [ "$1" != -- ]; do
  case $1 in --lock-dir) lock=$2; shift ;; --key) key=$2; shift ;; --status-fd) fd=$2; shift ;; esac
  shift
done
shift
if [ -f "$lock/$key.busy" ]; then
  [ -n "$fd" ] && eval "echo busy >&$fd"
  exit 75
fi
[ -n "$fd" ] && { eval "echo locked >&$fd"; eval "exec $fd>&-"; }
exec "$@"
